notes.title: Where The Crows Roam One Year Anniversary Edition
notes.content:
This Update Includes

• Lighting Fix
• Added Audio Logs/Record Players
• Added More Options To The Settings Menu
• Made Chase Music Less Loud
• Improved Some Rooms/Buildings
• Added A Cheap Pickle Easter Egg (if you know you know)
• Added Support For Lower End Devices With Potato Mode 
• Four Resolution Options
• In Game Controller Support (no menus)
• Edited The Ending Chase
• Fixed Some Minor Bugs
• Gave Some Chapter One Locations Clarity On What They Are
• Changed Purple Panda Games To Elam Isaacs Games
• Created A Free Demo That Has An Original Chapter 
• One Year Anniversary YouTube Celebration Video Coming 10/8/24


Thanks For One Year!!
Where The Crows Roam originally came out on GameJolt on the 8th of October last year. Later coming to Itch.io and now Steam. The third and final chapter launched April 3rd 2024 right here on steam. This game means a lot to me because it was my first REAL game. Plus it has a super unique art style that i really like. I just want to say thanks for all of the positive reviews and helpful feedback.
